# Nova Trace Step 11 — Analytics and Reports P3

Only run after Sprint 1 and core P2 pages are stable.

## Analytics

Create:
- score distribution histogram
- source comparison chart
- time analysis area chart
- domain distribution placeholder/treemap-ready component
- insight cards

## Reports

Create:
- report date range selector
- report preview shell
- export buttons as mock actions
- empty states and loading states

## Do not

- do not create real PDFs
- do not create real Excel exports
- do not add backend
- do not add payment logic

## Acceptance criteria

- `/analytics` and `/reports` feel consistent with Nova Trace
- charts are responsive
- export actions are mocked with toasts
- no build/type errors
